arguments.sql: SELECT c.card_type, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id GROUP BY c.card_type ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, c.card_type
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions grouped by card type, from the highest count down.
assumptions: Counts every transaction regardless of fraud label, including unlabelled ones.
Card type is taken from the cards table via card_id; 'Debit' and 'Debit (Prepaid)' are reported as separate types.
Transactions whose card_id has no matching card are excluded by the inner join.
